en: The postcard features a black-and-white photographic image of a riverside landscape with a person standing near the water and a dog, surrounded by trees and mountains in the background. The lower margin of the image contains printed and handwritten text. On the reverse, green printed text includes 'BREFKORT' and address lines filled with handwritten recipient information. There are Swedish postal marks and a partially visible date stamp.
